container_stopped.notes: Restart with bounded backoff; escalate at flap limit.

image_digest_mismatch.notes: Repair only to the promotion-signed digest.

compose_config_mismatch.notes: Render from fixed template; document cannot contain commands or hooks.

unknown_container.notes: Do not delete; contain network exposure and preserve for investigation.

unexpected_open_port.notes: Do not delete evidence; contain exposure and alert.

host_drift.notes: Reconciler never mutates packages, users, sshd or firewall; controlled Ansible handles host repair.

secret_drift.notes: Never overwrite secrets from desired state.

volume_drift.notes: Never prune, delete, recreate or auto-repair volumes.
